sections.title: Woman-owned, *certified, local*
body: G & P Construction, Hauling and Environmental is run by a woman-owned and operated management team, working out of Belair Road in North Augusta.

The team is certified by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers and the Naval Facilities Engineering Command, and takes on environmental, demolition and construction work for commercial and residential customers.
list: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers certified team

items.a: The EPA’s Renovation, Repair and Painting rule. Work that disturbs paint in homes, child care facilities and schools built before 1978 must be done by a certified firm using lead-safe practices.
Older buildings can hold asbestos, lead paint or mold. An inspection first shows what has to be removed safely before the walls come down.

items.q: Do you work on homes and businesses?
items.a: Yes: commercial and residential construction, renovation and demolition.

sections.title: Planning a renovation or demolition?
sections.text: Call the office on Belair Road, weekdays 7 to 6.
